description:
Outcome: household applies for coming season with up to three preferred plots, from brief.md First version 1.
Scope: authenticated mobile form, zero to three distinct valid choices, prior-holdings eligibility, durable submit/receipt and pending status. Excludes: guaranteed preferences, self-service edits and map.
Acceptance: one application per household-season, immutable initial server timestamp and stable ordering, retries never duplicate or reorder, coming season and configured application window clear.
Behaviour: invalid/closed/stale data explained; accessible loading/success and safe retries; no contacts exposed.
Verification: form/API tests for zero/one/three/four preferences, invalid/duplicate choices, retries and cutoff boundaries. Prerequisites: prototype checkpoint, records and passwordless access. Assumptions: coordinator configures application window; preferences optional.
title: Seasonal application
